title.narrative: Public participation: Sustainable & inclusive ocean economy in Colombia

description.narrative: The Project’s expected effect(s) on society is to strengthen fisheries sustainability and coastal livelihoods, through enhanced marine stewardship and local stakeholders’ engagement in resource use and conservation. The project seeks to contribute to climate adaption and mitigation by establishing Climate Change Adaptation Plans (CCAP) and building capacities for local implementation of management tools to facilitate the adaptation of the population and their way of life to the effects of global climate change; evaluating and showcasing the critical role of mangroves in contribution to climate change mitigation; generating recommendations for concrete measures to conserve mangrove coverage in Chocó. The project seeks to foster gender equality and women empowerment in grassroots communities by promoting women’s participation and leadership, and creating economic opportunities for women by including them as part of the value chains.
